The pavilion's construction features a lattice of bamboo, creating a dynamic visual effect that represents the evolving nature of contemporary Vietnamese architecture. According to architect Vu Dao Hoang, the head of the Top 10 Awards organizing committee, the awards serve as a high-quality filter within the industry, acknowledging exemplary works in residential, interior, and green architecture.

The pavilion, which is part of a larger exhibition celebrating the finest architectural designs from across the country, was designed to reflect the essence of Vietnamese culture while embracing modern innovation.
